edge_cases: A single character is a palindrome of length one, so a product is always available.
input_semantics: One parameter, s, a string of lowercase English letters.
load_bearing: Both substrings have ODD length, they do not share any position, and the quantity maximised is the product of their lengths.
output_semantics: A single integer: the largest achievable product of the two lengths.
required_operation: Find two non-overlapping palindromic substrings of a string, each of odd length, whose lengths have the largest possible product, and report that product.
source_basis: The question title and the boilerplate method name, both from this project's own bank. No sentence is copied from any external problem statement.
title: Maximum Product of the Length of Two Palindromic Substrings
